_units: distances in tiles, speeds in tiles/s, time in seconds of unpaused game time

economy._cacheNote: cache now gives 20 Energy + a 1-of-3 boon choice (boons.json)

workers._doc: [Антон 21:48] несколько жителей на одной клетке копают быстрее; MVP_RULES §4.2
workers.idleJoin: an idle resident with nothing in the queue joins the nearest cell being dug (up to maxPerCell)
workers.progressBar: one shared progress ring on the cell, workers stand on different free sides of it

cellDurability._doc: [Антон 2026-10-10 10:43] копка = урон по прочности клетки; у клеток стихия, слабость и сопротивление. MVP_RULES §3.4

cellWeakTo._doc: = elements.json beats: клетку быстро копают две стихии, которые бьют её стихию

cellDurability._armTierBonus: each trophy arm adds +10% dig power per tier when that arm is used
cellDurability.armChoice: each tick the hero digs with its own arm, a trophy arm, or kinetic (both arms stumps / draft backup) — whichever gives the highest multiplier for this cell
cellDurability.multiWorker: total = sum(each hero's power × its multiplier) × crowd; crowd = (1 + 0.75×(n−1)) / n → 1, 0.875, 0.833 (old 9 / 5.1 / 3.6 s kept for same-element workers)
cellDurability.heroPick: when the player queues a cell, the free hero with the best score goes: score = power×multiplier / (1 + distance/6). idleJoin uses the same score
cellDurability.hitFeedback: each tick the ring drops by a chunk and a damage number pops in the element's colour; weak hit = bigger number + «Уязвим!», resisted = grey number + «Стойко»

population._note: [Антон 2026-10-09] residents appear on a timer at the command center (or nearest Жилой блок), not per house
population.capNote: cap is fixed; Standard ally and meta can raise it

damageNumbers.event: every hit emits {targetId, amount (rounded int, after multipliers and defense), element (attack tech or kinetic), hitType: weak|neutral|resist|super|reaction|mine|status}
damageNumbers.show: number pops over target 0.6 s; colour = elements.json techs[].color; weak hit: bigger + «!», resist: smaller grey-tinted, super: «БАМ» size; status ticks (burn/poison) small; heals green «+N»
damageNumbers.aggregate: hits on the same target within 0.15 s merge into one number

warnings._note: QA B-1: player must see that waiting makes nests stronger

victory.target: boss_hatch hero (the hero named in the call)
victory._note: Mode «Срочный вызов: {hero}» (writer's name): each shift is a call against one maddened hero, chosen from heroes.json bossPool. The 3 other hero lairs are optional threats (they self-open on threat levels 2/4/6) and give parts for the target fight. [Антон] Demon is just one possible target.

residents.heroKillDrops: arm to killing blow, second part to next-highest damage dealer

rally._doc: QA B-2: residents must not trickle in one by one. MVP_RULES §4.3
rally.gatherPoint: cell 2 steps from the threat toward the command center
rally.engageWhen: gathered >= min(4, residents in radius) or 4 s passed or an enemy reaches the gather point

retreat.to: nearest home shelter or command center
retreat._note: command heals 2 HP/s at radius 1, home shelter protects

_difficulty: threat.secondsPerLevel, economy.startEnergy, assist default, boss wake and lair timings are overridden by data/difficulty.json

readability._doc: [Антон 21:26] полоски здоровья у всех + шарики стихий над злодеями

healthBars.when: always for heroes, buildings, command; others when damaged or in combat

weaknessOrbs.what: elements this enemy is weak to (resist > 1), one small orb per element in elements.json techs[].color; own tech shown as a small ring/frame of the bar

combat_stacking._note: damage of several residents on one target already adds up (each resident hits); sites (nests, lairs) and enemies have no cap on attackers except physical space: up to 8 around a cell

input._doc: [Антон 21:49] без переключателя Копать/Строить: действие по тому, куда тапнули. MVP_RULES §7.1
input.tapClosedCell: add to dig queue (swipe adds several); cell highlights at once
input.tapOpenCellInTerritory: open build menu for this cell
input.tapOpenCellOutsideTerritory: toast build.refuse.not_liberated + flash territory border + arrow to the nearest liberated cell
input.tapNumberCell: highlight 8 neighbours (ONBOARDING 1.2); a second tap on the same cell opens build menu if liberated

tempo._doc: progress score that drives stagnation and difficulty scaling
